units.source_text: 他想用尽最后的力量为自己写一个自传。

en.t: He wanted to use the last of his strength to write an autobiography for himself.

units.source_text: 不过这对他来说不是个简单的事儿。

en.t: But for him, this was no simple matter.

units.source_text: 这是因为他还残留着自尊心、怀疑主义和利害打算的缘故。

en.t: This was because self-respect, skepticism, and calculations of advantage and disadvantage still lingered in him.
He despised himself for being like this.

units.source_text: 但是另一方面，他又不由自主地想：

en.t: But on the other hand, he could not help thinking:

units.source_text: 倘若剥开一层皮来看，任何人都是一样的。

en.t: If one peeled away a layer of skin and looked underneath, everyone was the same.

units.source_text: 他认为，《诗与真实》这个书名，似乎可以充当一切自传的书名。

en.t: He thought that the title Poetry and Truth might serve as the title for every autobiography.

units.source_text: 他还很明白，文艺作品不一定让所有人都感动。

en.t: He also understood very well that literary works do not necessarily move everyone.
He also came to have this thought:

units.source_text: 只有那些和他经历相似并且和他相似的人才会被他的作品所感动。

en.t: Only those whose experiences resembled his, and who resembled him, would be moved by his work.

units.source_text: 就这样，他下定决心简短地写完自己的《诗与真实》。

en.t: In this way, he resolved to finish writing his own Poetry and Truth briefly.
